summary: Pivoted onboarding away from per-turn LLM streaming to a static question pool ranked by one cheap-tier LLM call. Plan 03-04 Task 3 (human visual verification) still outstanding but the surface being verified is now different — must re-test with new flow.
completed_this_session: Switched login from magic link to email+password (Supabase rate limit on OTP). Sign-up creates account; sign-in redirects to /dashboard.
Switched LLM provider to OpenAI only (user has no Anthropic key). Fixed aisdk.ts default for openai reasoning tier (was returning 'claude-sonnet-4-5').

Architectural pivot: dropped per-turn streaming/tool-calling interview. New flow is: (1) free-form 'about you' dump, (2) one GPT-4o-mini call picks 8 of ~30 pre-written questions, (3) user answers chips + optional per-Q free-text, (4) optional expander reveals remaining ~22 questions, (5) one GPT-4o synthesis call generates habit candidates with hybrid retrieval done server-side.

.planning/backlog/admin-question-pool-editor.md (future admin UI for question pool, post-MVP)

decisions.decision: Onboarding uses static question pool + LLM-ranked selection, not per-turn LLM-generated questions
decisions.rationale: Per-turn LLM streaming was slow, expensive, and unreliable (model 'thinking' then hanging). Static questions are curated, fast, predictable. AI's real job is at synthesis time.

decisions.decision: OpenAI-only stack — LLM_PROVIDER=openai env var set
decisions.rationale: User only has OpenAI API key. cheap=gpt-4o-mini (question selection), reasoning=gpt-4o (synthesis). Provider abstraction in packages/core/src/llm allowed this swap cleanly.

decisions.decision: Email + password login at MVP instead of magic link
decisions.rationale: Supabase free tier rate-limited the OTP endpoint during dev testing. Password auth is simpler for dev. Magic link can come back as an option later.

decisions.decision: Question pool lives in packages/core/src/interview/question-pool.ts as a TS const for now
decisions.rationale: Solo dev, 30 questions is small enough to edit in code. Backlog item .planning/backlog/admin-question-pool-editor.md captures the future admin UI when pool grows or non-engineers need to edit.

decisions.decision: Synthesis route does its own hybrid retrieval (no retrievedClipIds from client)
decisions.rationale: With no per-turn LLM, clips are never surfaced during the interview. Synthesis takes freeFormText + answer labels, builds a retrieval query, embeds it, calls hybridRetrieve, then feeds clips into the synthesis prompt. Cleaner separation.

env_required: Supabase: email confirmation should be DISABLED for dev (Auth -> Email settings)
